speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Trade and Industry (a) to what extent the recent Causeway jams have impacted businesses in Singapore; and (b) what measures are in place to reduce the extent and impact of such jams in future.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) regularly releases notices to anticipate jams, for example, during the year-end school holidays and festive periods on the Causeway.

speaker: The Minister for Trade and Industry (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Many of our companies will schedule deliveries to avoid peak periods and factor in additional travel time to buffer for any delays due to such seasonal factors or external circumstances.
